_NOTE: Lines for fares, Pedring's shop and the 'Susan's list' side quest (docs/ECONOMY_PLAN.md). Every entry with "draft": true is waiting for the user's one-line-at-a-time Akeanon review; do not mark verified without it. Tokens: {number} = the Akeanon number word for a price 1-10 (word bank w090...w178), {price} = the amount in digits, {item} = the item's Akeanon word, {item_en} = its English name. The money/fare word is still an open question (ECONOMY_PLAN open question 1), so prices show as ₱ and English until it is decided.

susan_offer_1.speaker: Lola Susan
susan_offer_1.text: \Apo, can you go to Nong Pedring's \tindahan for me?
susan_offer_1.translation: Apo, can you go to Nong Pedring's market stall for me?

susan_offer_2.speaker: Lola Susan
susan_offer_2.translation: Here's twenty pesos. My list: uncooked rice and dried fish.
susan_offer_2.note: ag (w005, and) is not verified in the word bank yet.

susan_offer_later.speaker: Lola Susan
susan_offer_later.text: That's fine, \apo. Ask me again later.
susan_offer_later.translation: That's fine, apo. Ask me again later.

susan_remind.speaker: Lola Susan
susan_remind.text: \Bugas \ag \uga, \apo. Nong Pedring is at the market.
susan_remind.translation: Uncooked rice and dried fish, apo. Nong Pedring is at the market.

susan_thanks.speaker: Lola Susan
susan_thanks.translation: Thank you, apo! Keep the change.
